source_request: 시각 의미 데이터화 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 5개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Create a randomized, complex, reference-informed photographic test of a Korean afterlife guide actively escorting one deceased traveler across a visible threshold, distinct from an abstract or Western personification of Death.
subject: An adult Korean afterlife guide and one translucent deceased traveler
setting: A flooded last-train subway platform opening into a moonlit reed river
event: The guide opens the threshold and personally leads the traveler across it
visual_priorities: Culturally bounded contemporary Korean visual language driven by action
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic cinematic night photograph on a flooded last-train subway platform that opens into a moonlit reed river. An unmistakably adult woman serves as a Korean afterlife guide. Her visible facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and understated natural styling follow the reference portrait. She carries a closed destination ledger against her chest and walks shoulder to shoulder with one translucent deceased traveler. The guide opens a luminous threshold door with her free hand and the traveler follows her gesture across it. One wet footprint changes into reflected starlight at the boundary, making the handoff visible. Show the guide, traveler, ledger, threshold, and transformed footprint in one coherent full-body composition, with contemporary dark layered clothing, rain reflections, and restrained moonlight.
